feature_mapping.description: Asterion's four caller-owned L2 features map 1:1, in order, onto the model's single-timestep [1, 1, 4] input. lookback == 1 reduces DeepLOB's multi-row window to a single row. The training distribution is standardised synthetic data whose scale differs from Asterion's L2 feature scale.

output_semantics: Raw 3-class logits [down, flat, up], not probabilities. Asterion reads output[0] as the scalar score for its inference path.
purpose: Trained ONNX artefact used to exercise Asterion inference-path model loading, feature-contract validation and deterministic scoring.

training.data_description: Seeded synthetic standardised (O(1)) 4-feature samples positionally aligned to Asterion's L2 feature ordering, with a 3-class label rule driven by imbalance and spread. Not FI-2010 and not market data; the toy scale differs from the L2 feature scale Asterion produces.
